offering_description.value: Old Dominion Freight Line transports freight for manufacturers, distributors, retailers, and other commercial shippers whose shipments take up less than a full trailer. It consolidates shipments from multiple customers and moves them through its service centers using its own fleet. It also provides expedited shipping and related logistics services.

primary_services.value: less-than-truckload freight transportation; expedited freight transportation; container drayage; truckload brokerage; supply chain consulting

customer_segment.value: B2B: Manufacturers, wholesalers, retailers, and third-party logistics providers

end_markets.value: manufacturing; wholesale distribution; retail and e-commerce; third-party logistics

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: Freight charges per shipment, including expedited delivery and accessorial charges; service fees: Container drayage, truckload brokerage, and supply chain consulting
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: Uses its fleet and service centers to consolidate and transport shipments for commercial shippers; service provider: Arranges truckload capacity and advises commercial shippers on freight and supply chains

geography_served.value: North America: Continental United States, with service to Canada and Mexico through carrier partners

specialization.value: related lines: Less-than-truckload and expedited shipping, container drayage, truckload brokerage, and supply chain consulting

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales representatives and account teams serving commercial shippers; online: Customer portal for rate quotes, shipment scheduling, and tracking; partners / resellers: Carrier partners extending service into Canada and Mexico

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Interstate for-hire trucking requires FMCSA operating authority and compliance with federal motor carrier safety rules

notes: The current extent of service beyond North America through partners is uncertain.
